notes.title: SHPR - UPDATE 5.0 - LAST CONTENT UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello guys!
This is the last content update for this game.
Before going into what has been added, I would want to thank you for playing the game!
It was an amazing experience to develop this game alongside you guys that provided me with the necessary feedback.
It didn't go very well if you compare it to the industry standard, but I am more than pleased with it since it is my first ever experience with publishing and managing a game of this scale.
It will definitely not be my last project as I am working on another game at the moment, so stay tuned!

[h1]NEW ITEMS[/h1]
[list]
[*]Engineer - 1/2/3 stationary machineguns will spawn in a random position and will shoot at enemies. The bullets fired by them will apply on hit effects
[*]Laser gun - Each time you fire 4/3/2 bullets a laser will hit a random enemy dealing damage to it
[/list]

And as always, see you guys next time! ːCoolRockː

Join our Discord server for the latest updated on the upcoming projects!
https://discord.gg/JX8mm5Umqm

notes.title: SHPR 3.0 - small update
notes.content:
Hello!
This is a very small update that includes the option to unpause the game using the "Escape" key and a countdown to prevent accidental damage since the player would be forced to move their mouse to the center of the screen when resuming.

notes.title: SHPR - Version 4.0
notes.content:
Hello guys!
This is one of the most extensive updates for this game so far!
It includes 8 new items, the option to freeze items and interest for the shop.  
Income/items cost have changed and the enemies and items received many other balance changes and overall improvements.
Some of the levels were redone, some items received small buffs/nerfs so expect a more balanced experience.

[h1]NEW ITEMS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42413163/c08be8caa76025e8fd80423bade31f2621043fbc.png[/img]
[i](Level 1 effects for each item)[/i]

[h1]BALANCE CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*] The HP of some enemies has been modified.
[*] Many of the already existing enemies received small changes, including nerfs and buffs.
[/list]
[h1]CHANGES TO THE SHOP[/h1]
[list]
[*] Multiplied all income and items costs by 10 to allow for easier balancing.
[*] Added an option to freeze items and keep them for the next level.
[*] Added interest, giving to the player more room to create their own strategy (buying items normally, waiting for gold to pile up and take advantage of that later on or finding a middle point between them)
[*] The level 2 and 3 version of every items will cost less
[/list]

See ya next time ːCoolRockː

If you want to support me even further, join the ZokerinoDev Discord server!

notes.title: SHPR - Version 3.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
I am here once again presenting you the changes in the newest update!
As most of you already know, the game was in a pretty unbalanced state. A build could easily beat the game within a blink of an eye, while some of them would even struggle to keep up with the basic enemies.
All the levels and stages were completely redone, enemies are now more balanced, and items as well.
The game has also received many UI improvements, bug fixes and Quality Of Life changes.
They include, but are not limited to:

[h1]NEW ITEMS[/h1]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42413163/61e0985a6a73f4a32649934c8c455009b547d308.png[/img][*] [u][b][u]X is a value that changes accordingly to the level of each item[/u][/b][/u]
[/list]

[h1]NEW ENEMIES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Hexagon - A ranged enemy that will periodically shoot many waves of bullets in multiple directions
[*] Lasers - They will spawn periodically starting from the second stage, as shown in the difficulty screen
[*] Elites - They are versions of the already existing enemies. They are stronger, bigger and their abilities are empowered.
[/list]

[h1]BALANCE CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*] The HP of all enemies has been modified.
[*] The bosses will no longer spawn their smaller counterpart infinitely, making it more beatable for certain builds.
[*] Many of the items received tweaks.
[/list]

[h1]UI CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a [b]STATS[/b] tab in the menu so you can see how much damage you deal, your range, etc.
[*] Modifier the [b]ITEMS[/b] tab so it shows the effects of each item, based on level.
[/list]

[h1]CHANGES TO THE SHOP[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reduced the amount of gold received
[*] Tweaked the cost of some items. 
[*] The cost of an item will now increase to 2/3 if you upgrade it.
[*] All weapons will now cost 2 gold each.
[*] Modified the description of every item to show their effect more accurately based on the level they have
[/list]

See ya next time ːCoolRockː

If you want to support me even further, join the ZokerinoDev Discord server!

notes.title: Early access v2.0
notes.content:
A new early access version of the game has just launched!!
Due to the recent feedback from reviews and our [url=https://discord.gg/AQFA8SU6rJ]discord community[/url] regarding the slow pacing of the game and the shop, I've decided to make the following changes:

[h1]A NEW SHOP SYSTEM:[/h1]
[list]
[*] A classic approach to buying/upgrading items
[*] Added an option to reroll the shop and upgrade the items in the same place
[*] If you perform great (not taking damage), you will get more gold to spend in the shop
[*] Added a tab that displays gold sources
[/list]
[h1]
ITEMS BALANCING:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Because many players pointed out that the game is very slow and only a few items are viable in the early-mid game, many items received some balance changes (mostly, the items that modify your damage, attack speed, spread, magazine size and even range)
[/list]


[h1][b]OTHER QUALITY OF LIFE CHANGES:[/b][/h1]

[b]STAGES[/b]
[list]
[*] A new way of making the game more engaging
[*] After you beat a stage you will be able to progress to the next one
[*] Each stage applies different modifiers to the game (enemies with more hp or damage, better bosses, etc)
[/list]
[b]UI CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] new menu 
[*] Added some background effects in most places in the game (except the arena, settings, etc.) 
[*] Now you can see the name of your items and what they do from the "INVENTORY" tab (not just icons of the items) 
[*] fixed a few UI bugs
[/list]
[b]WIN SCREEN[/b]
[list]
[*] Level 20 is the final level of the game, for now (more will be added after there will be more bosses/enemies in the game)
[*] After finishing a run you will be sent there. Here you can see all the items that you had in that run
[/list]
[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] The most significant one is fixing a soft lock that occurred when killing a square enemy while it was still outside of the arena by spawning more square enemies that would just fly away from the arena infinitely.
[*] Trail rendering issues (enemy bullets not having a trail, rockets from triangle boss having a different color trail)
[/list]
[url=https://discord.gg/AQFA8SU6rJ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42413163/b5a2eb2c1160dff2713b9af218bd8963f534912b.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: SHPR is out in Early Access!
notes.content:
SHPR is now out in Early acces! 

[i][b]Why Early Access?[/b][/i]
“The base mechanics of the game pretty much done, but they require some testing and feedback from the community.
I am looking for feedback not only related to small improvements/bug fixes but also amazing content I would be able to add to the game.

(Please take note that the items/enemies/bosses are not yet balanced out, so give us some time on this one)”

[i][b]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/b][/i]
“The game is supposed to be in early acces for approximately two months.”

[i][b]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/b][/i]
“In the final version I plan to add more enemies, items and new boss fights as well as achievements and full controller support.”

[i][b]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/b][/i]
“The game is in a playable state and the mechanics are fully functional.”

[i][b]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/b][/i]
“I plan to gradually raise the price as new features are being added.”

[i][b]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/b][/i]
“I am going to take notes from every suggestion from the community and try to implement them in the best way possible!”
